Name: Circular motion
Basic relationship:
[r] -> [v] -> [a]
d[r]/dt = [v](t) = [\O]*[r](t)
[\O] axis of rotation, point upward

Name: Rotational frames

Basic relationship:
[A] = d[V]/dt = d/(dt)([v] + [\O]*[R]) = d^2x/(dt^2)[`3i] + dx/(dt)*d*[`3i]/(dt) + d^2y/(dt^2)[`3j] + dy/(dt)*d*[`3j]/(dt) + d^2z/(dt^2)[`3k] + dz/(dt)*d*[`3k]/(dt) + [\O]*d*[R]/(dt) = [a] + [\O]*[v] + [\O]*[V] = [a] + 2[\O]*v + [\O]*([O]*R)
Coriolis acceleration: 2[\O]*[v]
Centripetal acceleration: [\O]*([O]*[R])

m[a] = [F] - 2m[\O]*[v] - m[\O]*([\O]*[R])
Coriolis force: - 2m[\O]*[v]
Centrifugal force: - m[\O]*([\O]*[R])

Name: Piecewise smooth curves
Torsion
Basic relationship:
\k(s) != 0 -> exist \t(s) torsion in d[B]/(ds) = -\t(s)[N](s)

d[B]/(ds) = d[T]/(ds)*[N] + [T]*d[N]/(ds) = \k[N]*[N] + [T]*d[N]/(ds) = [T]*d[N]/(ds)
d[B]/(ds) both perpendicular to [T] and [B] -> parallel with [N]

Name: The fundamental theorem of space curves
General parametrization
Basic relationship:
[v] = d*[r]/(dt) = d*[r]/(ds)*(ds)/(dt) = v[T]
[a] = d*[v]/(dt) = (dv)/(dt)*[T] + v*d*[T]/(dt) = (dv)/(dt)*[T] + v*d*[T]/(ds)*(ds)/dt) = (dv)/(dt)[T] + v^2\k*[N] <- Tangental + normal acceleration
[v]*[a] = v[T]*(dv/(dt)[T]) + v^3\k[T]*[N] = v^3\k*[B]
